**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject duplicate models in candidate rankings**

When a schema-v2 collaboration receipt is ingested, a caller can replace a lower-ranked candidate's `modelId`/`familyId` with the top candidate's values, recompute the unkeyed receipt ID, and pass this validation because only the candidate count is constrained; the later loop verifies that each entry exists in the bank but never that models are distinct. `buildModelTraceRecord` cannot produce such a ranking because the scorer emits one result per bank model, so require unique candidate model identities in both runtime and schema validation before accepting the receipt as canonical.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L23-L23](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/84cb87e1f094bd53506d2d2419eefdf38f8c3a70/AGENTS.md#L23-L23)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep challenge context inputs outside the checkout**

When `challenge` is invoked with `--context` pointing inside the checkout, this path reads the private session ID and context declarations without the containment check applied to every `score` input. The command succeeds and leaves that private context file available for staging; copying it outside before publication also means the publisher's check of the later supplied path cannot detect the original. Apply the same realpath-based outside-repository check to the challenge context before reading it.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L23-L23](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/84cb87e1f094bd53506d2d2419eefdf38f8c3a70/AGENTS.md#L23-L23)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Verify the scorer before importing executable code**

When the vendored scorer is modified or replaced in a checkout, this static import executes that file before `loadBank()` compares its bytes with `SCORER_DIGEST`. A malicious scorer can therefore read `process.argv`, environment credentials, or private ModelTrace files and perform arbitrary side effects before the checksum error is raised, defeating the claimed integrity and privacy boundary. Load executable scorer code only from the bytes after their digest has been verified, with the verification and evaluation protected against replacement races.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L23-L23](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/84cb87e1f094bd53506d2d2419eefdf38f8c3a70/AGENTS.md#L23-L23)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind collaboration receipts to measurement chronology**

When a schema-v2 collaboration receipt embeds a ModelTrace receipt measured after the claimed mutation, `validateModelTraceReceipt` accepts its structure and this check verifies only the repository, so ingestion treats the later measurement as attribution for the earlier write. This permits retroactive ModelTrace attachment—the existing synthetic receipt path even accepts `verifiedAt` values preceding `modelTrace.measuredAt`—despite the requirement that measurement be current before a write. Require the measurement to precede the receipt's verified mutation time and, where available, bind freshness to the platform object's write timestamp.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L23-L23](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/84cb87e1f094bd53506d2d2419eefdf38f8c3a70/AGENTS.md#L23-L23)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reconcile publications before enforcing receipt freshness**

When an Issue, PR, comment, or body update was already published but the acknowledgement was lost or the command is rerun after the receipt expires, this unconditional `measure()` call fails freshness before `findPublished()` can perform its read-only marker/full-body reconciliation. Supplying a new measurement does not recover the operation because its disclosure changes the expected full body, so an unknown successful write can no longer be resolved through the supported publisher. Fresh evidence beyond the earlier collaboration-validation issue is that this separate publisher path blocks its own idempotent readback; load and validate the historical bound record for reconciliation, then require freshness only immediately before a mutation.

## Owner-directed permanent retirement

Remove ModelTrace completely from future Agent commits and current publication/review workflows. This is permanent removal, not a dot exemption, optional measurement mode or replacement fingerprinting scheme.

- Delete the collector/scorer, vendored bank, CLI, receipt/context schemas, commit-message hook, identify skill, exemption code and measurement-only tests.
- Remove admission, freshness checks, disclosure construction and obsolete options from commit, publication, collaboration, review and connector paths.
- Remove the requirement from current Skills, repository guidance, governance/contributor pages, GitHub templates and generated coverage footer source. Preserve dated historical records and unrelated benchmark model identifiers.
- Preserve genuine DCO/source ownership, scoped authorization, live permission, exact branch/head/tree checks, idempotency and unknown-write reconciliation.
- Preserve already-sealed evidence bytes via their approved `--body-digest`; retain the normal target-bound marker path for unsealed publication.

## Executed acceptance evidence

Source: `00dc091f846f7f92985835e1a24df340dfcb5b50`; authorized tree: `56b961a591c646b8176ffb83142a8425cb1e7e6b`.

The actual supported publisher ran with `PUI_AGENT=1`, human-assisted/current-user authorization, the exact contributor branch/head/tree, and no measurement record/context arguments. It created this real commit with the configured contributor's genuine sign-off and returned `status: published` after immutable message/parent/tree readback. This is a real contributor-workflow smoke, not just a parser test.

Negative native Git controls also passed: a commit hook that removes the genuine committer trailer while leaving `Not-Signed-off-by` yields `PublicationUnknown` after exactly one attempt, never success or retry. Matching genuine pre-existing sign-offs publish successfully; another author's sign-off does not replace the committer's DCO. Sealed evidence body changes reject before any GitHub mutation.

- Agent operations structure: passed.
- Contributor Skills/registry/schema checks: passed, including the final post-review run.
- Agent snapshot generation and `check:agent-doc`: passed.
- Final affected publisher/publication-binding suites: **133/133 passed**, no skipped/cancelled cases.
- Earlier complete serial AgentOps run: 1,460 passed / 3 failed. All three failures were obsolete exact separator-newline assertions in native Git commit tests; those assertions were removed in favor of authored-content preservation and Git's actual trailer values.
